The 23 candidates split into plants and animals.

Plants: cactus, grass, oak tree, rose, seaweed, sunflower (6).
Animals: the other 17.

Asking "Is it a plant?" splits 6 to 17. Asking "Is it a mammal?" splits roughly 6 to 17 as well: cat, cow, dog, dolphin, elephant, hedgehog, horse is 7 mammals.

"Does it have legs?" would put the yes side at bee, butterfly, cat, chicken, cow, dog, eagle, elephant, frog, hedgehog, horse, penguin, spider (13) and the no side at 10 (cactus, dolphin, goldfish, grass, oak tree, rose, seaweed, shark, snake, sunflower). That is close to even.
